title: Neon Compute Endpoint
description: A Neon compute endpoint provides the processing resources for executing database queries against a branch. Each branch supports one read-write endpoint and multiple read-only endpoints with configurable autoscaling.

host.description: The hostname for connecting to this endpoint

project_id.description: The project ID this endpoint belongs to

branch_id.description: The branch ID this endpoint is attached to

region_id.description: The cloud region where this endpoint is deployed

type.description: The endpoint type determining read/write access

current_state.description: The current operational state of the endpoint

suspend_timeout_seconds.description: Seconds of inactivity before the endpoint is automatically suspended to save resources

provisioner.description: The provisioner type used for this endpoint

created_at.description: Timestamp when the endpoint was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the endpoint was last updated
